idea-plugin.name: Network Inspector Shared Rules
idea-plugin.description:
Share Android Studio Network Inspector → Rules with your team through git.
  • Rules live in team folders: network-inspector-rules/<team>/*.json (e.g. login/, checkout/), as readable JSON with JSON bodies stored as real JSON.
  • Export writes the rules you choose to their team files.
  • Import copies rules files from anywhere on disk into a team folder.
  • Refresh loads the team folders into the Rules tab (as [team] name) and sends the rules to the connected app straight away.
  • Create Team… makes a new team folder with a starter rules.json.
  • Turn On/Off by File… switches a whole scenario file on or off at once, just for you.
  • Rename Team… and Delete Team… manage team folders.
  • A Variables tab next to Rules lists shared variables (committed in team files), local variables (only on your machine, never committed, optionally declared in a team file) and missing ones, and lets you add, remove, share or make them local.
  • Emails and tokens typed into rules are caught before they're written to a team file, with an offer to replace them by local variables.
  • Create Network Rule from Endpoint…: right-click a Retrofit method to make a rule for it, with a sample response built from its return type. Set your base URL under Settings → Tools → Network Inspector Shared Rules.
  • Rules files get completion and error highlighting in the editor.
  • Teams… lets each developer hide teams they don't need.
  • The Rules tab groups rules by team, and each team can be collapsed or expanded by clicking its header.
  • A Team dropdown above the rule details saves the selected rule to a team file as [team] name.
  • The buttons appear in the Rules tab toolbar and under Tools → Network Inspector Shared Rules.
Each developer chooses which rules are enabled; that choice is never committed.
